newsitem.title: USA: Kyle downgraded from tropical storm to depression.
newsitem.headline: Kyle downgraded from tropical storm to depression.

text.p: Tropical Storm Kyle was downgraded to a depression on Saturday before reaching the Central American mainland, the National Hurricane Centre said.
"All warnings are discontinued," forecaster Ed Rappaport said, adding that rains could still bring flash floods and mudslides when the depression hits land.
The depression was off the coast of the Honduras-Guatemala border just north of Puerto Cortes in Honduras, moving west at about two mph. Maximum winds had decreased to 35 mph and were weakening.
"It is expected to move inland and dissipate in the next day or so," Rappaport said.
At 11 a.m. EDT its position was latitude 16 north and longitude 88.1 west.
Kyle grew out of stormy weather left behind by last week's Tropical Storm Josephine, which pushed through northern Florida and along the U.S. Eastern seaboard.
